name: nuclear mitotic apparatus protein 1

function.text: NUMA1 encodes nuclear mitotic apparatus protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include structural molecule activity and microtubule binding. It participates in nucleus organization and anastral spindle assembly.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: NUMA1–RARA rearrangements have been described in acute promyelocytic leukemia.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
